body:
Adds `transformData` parameter to the menu and refinementList widgets for review before implementing everywhere.

See #116 .

comments.body:
Have to admit my comment abt identity is driven by the fact I would want to avoid using lodash where we can bc with our current setup we have all es5 and es6 features which are covering some good code from lodash.

And lodash is quite big unfortunately
Well about using lodash, don't we have it as dependency already? All the goodness from babel won't bring us any of the API from lodash. And we're only scratching what we can get from it...

> Well about using lodash, don't we have it as dependency already?

It's true, babel does bring us the basics, merge (not deep), all ES5 and ES6 array methods but it's still way lower than lodash I do agree.

Still lodash is HUGE! And I fear that sometimes we can be lazy on the data structure we design because we know we can just use find({prop}, collection), that's another discussion.
@vvo @bobylito I've committed a version without lodash. I have no preference, you?
I'm still thinking about another naming than `transformData` but cannot find better right now; so LGTM.

> I have no preference, you?

me neither :)

If we don't use lodash, it's totally fine with me :)

LGTM too

title: feat(transformData): refinementList + menu implementation
